title: Operator Sandbox: Scaling Simulations & Change Playbook
creator: Amina Patel
description:
Problem: Operators need a low-risk, observable way to author, preview, and apply fleet-level scaling policy changes for Dedicated capacity without causing customer-visible throughput drops. Current console panels expose raw controls and a change log but lack a simulation surface, headroom visualization, and a reversible execution plan.

Goal: Add an "operator sandbox" within the Fleet Controls Console where operators can: (1) author autoscaling policy changes and guardrails, (2) run deterministic "what-if" simulations against recent workload traces, (3) preview throughput/latency headroom charts and cost delta estimates, and (4) stage an execution plan with canary/rollback steps and an auditable change record.

Scope of this ticket: product-facing spec, acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and companion runbook for on-call. Engineering work (policy engine, sim runner, telemetry hooks) will be tracked in ENG-41290 and ENG-41902. Design explorations are referenced in the attachments.

Acceptance criteria:
- A new Fleet Controls tab called "Operator Sandbox" is present in the console navigation for users with fleet-admin role.
- Users can create a policy draft (scaling rules, min/max pool sizes, cooldowns, scaling metrics) and choose a recent 24h workload trace to run a simulation.
- Simulation returns: projected throughput (p50/p95 token throughput), latency distribution, estimated additional GPU-hours, and a simple risk score.
- A timeline scrubber visualizes the simulated effect over the chosen time window and highlights potential SLO breaches.
- Users can stage a rollout plan with canary fraction, rollout duration, and automatic rollback threshold. Staging generates a previewable change-set and an immutable execution plan that appears in the change history.
- All staged and applied changes create audit entries (operator, timestamp, diff, reason) that are queryable from the main Fleet change history panel.
- Basic keyboard accessibility and responsive behaviours for the sandbox controls and timeline.

Non-goals: full policy language v2, RBAC redesign, or on-prem installer updates (those are separate follow-ups).

updates: 2026-03-02 — Kickoff: PM, design, and infra sync. Decided simulation will accept recent real traces (24h/7d) and a lightweight synthetic mode for quick previews.
2026-03-03 — Design review: prefer a timeline scrubber over static charts. UX suggests showing 'headroom band' and an overlay for predicted SLO violations. Liam to prototype interactive scrubber.

2026-03-04 — Engineering spike: ENG-41290 validated that trace replay with existing batching simulator is feasible; need two new telemetry hooks to capture per-route token emit rates. Estimated 3 backend sprints.

2026-03-05 — Security flagged audit retention requirement (7 years) for staged execution plans; added to non-goals to scope later but flagged for compliance track (security_review_required=false for now).
2026-03-06 — PM note: add cost delta estimator to help operators evaluate trade-offs; will use current pricing model + GPU-hour estimate from simulator.

2026-03-07 — Design/PM sync: Accessibility checklist added. Also agreed on an immutable 'execution plan' model that will be appended to the existing change history as a top-level entry with diff and links to the staged draft.
2026-03-08 — Status: In Progress. Design mockups updated; engineering onboarding completed. Next: prototype sandbox UI and basic simulation pipeline (backend) in ENG-41290.
